scholarships.title: ERS Visiting Mid-Career Investigator Travel (VISIT) Grant

eligibility: Mid-career investigator, clinician or allied healthcare professional transitioning to a more established career stage
Qualification profile for the portfolio is PhD, MD(Resp) or equivalent
Visit must take place at an institute in Europe or abroad, other than the applicant's own country
Not for clinical training and not for research projects, which are covered by the ERS fellowship programmes instead
The applicant is solely responsible for identifying a suitable host institution and supervisor
existing.eligibility_summary: Mid-career investigators, clinicians and allied healthcare professionals who hold a PhD, an MD in respiratory medicine or an equivalent qualification, and who want to visit an institution outside their home country for up to one month; the host institution must not be in the applicant's country.
benefits: Funding for a visit of up to one month at a host institution outside the applicant's home country
coverage: Funding for a visit of up to one month at a host institution outside the applicant's home country
requirements: Agreement of the host institution, evidenced by the Host Institution Invitation Form
Support from the home supervisor, evidenced by the Home Supervisor Support Form
Application prepared using the VISIT Grant Application Guidance 2026
Own arrangement of the host institution and supervisor
application_method: Download the ERS VISIT Application Form 2026 and submit it in accordance with the VISIT Grant Application Guidance 2026
existing.selection_notes: ERS states that the choice of host institution remains the candidate's prerogative and that the responsibility for identifying the most suitable institution and supervisor rests entirely with the applicant. Decisions are notified in mid-February 2027.
existing.best_fit: Mid-career respiratory clinicians, investigators and allied health professionals with a PhD or an MD in respiratory medicine who can arrange a one-month visit to a host institution abroad.
existing.notes: Because the host institution is applicant-arranged, this grant suits mid-career professionals who can secure a supervisor themselves. The published programme page does not state the grant value or the currency, and the VISIT Grant Application Guidance 2026 is hosted on a Box link rather than on ersnet.org.
existing.program_type: Professional association international visit and networking grant
